scientific_integrity: Self-contained balancing argument and exact polar integral; independently checked exact finite computations. No independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to complete-bipartite unit-edge shortest-path metrics and finite real Lipschitz-free spaces. The primal volume is a known consequence of the symmetric-edge h-star formula; only the dual volume and joint partition-balancing/equality theorem are proposed as new. Primary-source coverage may be incomplete.
title: Sharp balance law for Mahler products of complete-bipartite transportation spaces
